title: docs(pm-dispatch): the seat that sees a main-red files and dispatches it; triage first-touch follows
body:
Fixes #26143
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Skill text only, four files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (Tier S), every file line-neutral against its `check-skill-line-ratchet` ceiling, every touched line at or under 120 bytes, no issue numbers in operative text.

**`references/landing-operations.md` §B — the main-red convention gains its actor.** 约定① now reads: the seat that sees a full-battery red on `main` or a merge-queue build looks for the anchor card first; finding none, it files the p0 anchor card (filing-gate class ①) with the failing surface's lane domain, claims it, and dispatches the stanch — in the words the card asks for, `⛔ 不等分诊首触、不等维护者`. The first stanch is the revert of the commit that introduced the red, found on `main` between the last green and the first red; root cause goes on its own card. Triage first-touch follows after the fact and may change the domain, never the action. The two existing conventions stay: p0 fix-forward jumps the queue (mechanical, root cause verified) and the maintainer may hand-merge a one-line fix — compressed from two lines to one; 约定② (one failing check anchors one card, first filer wins, later seers comment on the anchor) is byte-unchanged. The fourth existing convention, no lane PR arms the queue meanwhile, lives in `AGENTS.md`'s Two-speeds paragraph and was never in this file.

**`references/execution-duties.md` — the candidate rule gains main-red as its second exception**, in the same shape as the sub-issue clause: line 10 names both exceptions and points at `landing-operations.md`; line 40 (dispatched past triage, sweep audits after) now covers both instead of being duplicated.

**`references/triage-duties.md` — one line beside the urgent-triage rule** tells the triage seat that a main-red anchor the seat already filed and dispatched still gets its first touch, as a recorded grade: domain may change, action never, and the card's in-flight state is no reason to skip it. The blanket "in-flight cards are not touched" line (70) names that first touch as an exception so the two lines cannot be read against each other.

**`SKILL.md` lines 170–171, edited in place** (no line added): `domain:*` production and the queue/level/claim-eligibility line now say 两例外 (sub-issue, main-red anchor) instead of 例外一. Without this the new rule would contradict SKILL.md's own "only triage produces `domain:*`" and "no triage audit, no claim" lines, and SKILL.md's stricter-rule tie-break would have sent the seat back to waiting for triage. The lane charter `references/lanes/skills.md` line 「本车道 finding 同走分诊席首触,⛔ 不自分诊」 is untouched: it is about lane findings, and main-red is now the named exception.

Not touched, by the card's own scope: `AGENTS.md`'s main-red sentence ("triage files it") is Tier H prose and is the seat's to raise with the maintainer; machine-filed anchor cards (option B) were not chosen.

## Acceptance notes

- Cross-lane claiming of the anchor: the ruling says the seat that sees the red claims it, and the failing surface's lane may not be that seat's lane. The text states the ruling as given; the existing cross-lane channel it rides is `SKILL.md` line 175 「接手无主阻塞项」 together with `execution-duties.md` line 45 (阻塞项无主 ⇒ 被挡席认领做掉) — a main-red blocks every lane's landing. The 红线 line 34 (执行席只在本车道认领) is not edited; the maintainer's ruling outranks it by `SKILL.md`'s own 优先序. Named for the seat's review, not resolved here.
- The after-the-fact clause (首触事后补,可改域、⛔ 不改动作) appears twice on purpose: once in landing-operations §B from the acting seat's side, once in triage-duties from the triage seat's side, where the in-flight exemption also has to be said.
- Carrier: the seat raises `AGENTS.md`'s "triage files it" sentence with the maintainer (Tier H, the maintainer's hand only); noted, not filed.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

pm-dispatch 技能里的 main-red 约定补上了「谁来做」:看见主干或合并队列全量红的席位先找锚卡,没有就自己立 p0 锚卡(域按出红的面所属车道)、认领、派止血;首道止血是回退引入红的那个提交,根因另立卡;⛔ 不等分诊首触、不等维护者。分诊首触事后补,可以改域、不改动作。既有约定(一个签名一张卡、p0 fix-forward 跳队、维护者可直合一行修复、止血期间车道 PR 不挂队列)全部保留。执行席的候选规则把 main-red 锚卡列为 sub-issue 之外的第二个免分诊例外;分诊席职责加一行:在飞的 main-red 锚卡照样补首触,只作记录级。四个文件行数一行不增,全部按 120 字节/行写。

### 为什么改

你 2026-10-26 在席位线程的原话:「主干 Test Core 超时红这种应该立刻立卡啊,skills 没有约定吗?」「所以 main红这一类卡应该是 devx 立卡并立刻处理吗」「按照目前的规则,等分诊太慢了」,决策卡上选的是「席位直接立卡派发,分诊后补」。当天实测的延迟全在「看见红 → 立卡」这一段(两个半小时),立卡之后 47 分钟就修好了。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 风险一:主干红时可能出现两张锚卡。约定②(一个签名一张卡、先立者赢、后见者评论到锚卡)原样保留,sweep 事后查重,重复的关 duplicate。
- 风险二:看见红的席位可能跨车道认领。规则文本照裁决写「认领并派止血」,走的是既有「接手无主阻塞项」越界通道;红线「执行席只在本车道认领」没有动,按技能自己的优先序由裁决压过。席位复核时请留意这一点。
- 代价:为保持行数不增,从 landing-operations 退了两行 Tier S/Tier H 说明(SKILL.md 路径分叉与 contract-review.md 已有同样的规则),从 triage-duties 退了一行「裁决归人工」(SKILL.md 红线第 30 行原文)。所有退掉的内容在 PR 正文「Rules retired」逐条列了去处。
- 回滚:revert 这一个提交即可,无数据、无发布面、无门禁常量改动。
